CustomField.label: Contact Count
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of DISTINCT contacts linked to this opportunity. Blank means nobody has ever been recorded.
CustomField.description: Deliberately NOT a roll-up summary. A roll-up counts Opportunity_Contact__c rows, and 62 (opportunity, contact) pairs are linked twice, so a roll-up would report 2 where one person is listed twice. This field counts distinct Contact ids instead.
